scope: Exactly three genuine PART1 guard paths using the canonical CPU Release program, plus a native loader-only real OFF positive control. No coupled restart acceptance, no source change, no new simulation.

writer.positive_control: Load the genuine OFF PART1 through the actual native JPartsLoad4 loader. Verify 512 IDs and ID-aligned positions, velocity/density, six double stresses, plastic state and p/p0. This is loader-only, not a coupled restart.
writer.change: Copy genuine OFF Part_0001.bi4; materialize lazy arrays through native API, close its file structure, add only DatBool HydroMechDynamicSeepage=false under its native PART item, save/reload using JBinaryData SaveFile.
writer.preservation: Recursively capture item topology/hide flags, every scalar name/type/typed value bits and all 15 array name/type/count/hide/raw bytes. After reload remove only the new scalar from the comparison and require complete equality; re-read and hash-check original PART unchanged. Scalar ordering/file serialization need not be byte-identical, but all existing values and all array bits must be.
not_allowed: Calling a solver or force/integrator from the writer

cases.label: ON_from_OFF
cases.expected_exception: HydroMechDynamicSeepage is experimental: fresh CPU 2-D, zero gravity, InitMode=None and positive constant DtFixed only.

cases.label: OFF_from_ON
cases.expected_exception: Dynamic/J-state PART restart is not supported; refusing to discard the porosity state even when the dynamic switch is OFF.

cases.PART: real OFF PART1 scratch with sole new false scalar
cases.expected_exception: Dynamic/J-state PART restart is not supported; refusing to discard the porosity state even when the dynamic switch is OFF.

gates.prior: CPU full Rebuild r3/default OFF140 and all three canonical half reviews passed and all bound source/build/runtime/input hashes unchanged.
gates.writer: Native loader positive control succeeds, exact preservation check succeeds and only false metadata scalar is added; no solver or integration called.
gates.each_negative: Canonical owned call exits nonzero with the exact intended guard message. New output contains zero numbered Part_####.bi4 frames, no Initialising simulation loop marker/native-save marker. Part_Head, if created, is recorded separately and never mistaken for a physical save.
gates.no_step_claim: Early source guard and absence of loop/native save evidence; no fabricated runtime step counter or claim that arbitrary absence proves all code paths.
gates.preserve: Each action refuses existing output/log/receipt. Failed compile/writer/rejection labels remain evidence, never rerun or rearm.
gates.physics: No tolerance, physics, production file, accepted formal data or retained native output changes.

execution.owner: Root reviews all three new files before any compile/call. This author performs no execution.
